crossRefs.note: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

translations.web: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.
translations.bsb: So he consented to this and tested them for ten days.
translations.kjv: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
translations.asv: So he hearkened unto them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
